COLDWAR_DDR_pact_talks_category = {
	COLDWAR_DDR_renew_the_moscow_negotiations = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_independence
		cost = 50
		days_re_enable = 365
		fire_only_once = no
		available = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_release_refused }
			country_exists = SOV
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_DDR_renew_the_moscow_negotiations"
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_we_the_moscow_negotiations }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV NOT = { tag = SOV } } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.100 days = 1 } } }
				custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
				effect_tooltip = {
					SOV = {
						end_puppet = ROOT
						set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -2 }
						mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
						ROOT = {
							country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.62 days = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_REJECT
				effect_tooltip = {
					SOV = {
						ROOT = {
							custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_minus_10_tt
							hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = -10 } COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = yes }
							set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_release_refused days = 365 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV NOT = { tag = SOV } } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.101 days = 1 } } }
				custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
				effect_tooltip = {
					SOV = {
						end_puppet = ROOT
						set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -1 }
						mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
						ROOT = {
							country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.62 days = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_REJECT
				effect_tooltip = {
					SOV = {
						ROOT = {
							custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_minus_10_tt
							hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = -10 } COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = yes }
							country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.32 days = 3 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

COLDWAR_DDR_military_council_category = {
	COLDWAR_DDR_return_to_civilian_rule = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_independence
		cost = 50
		fire_only_once = yes
		visible = {
			nationalist_military_junta_are_in_power = yes
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_DDR_return_to_civilian_rule"
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_civilian_rule_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_best = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_best_pop = 0 }
				for_loop_effect = {
					start = 0
					end = 24
					value = i
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { i = 22 } } NOT = { check_variable = { i = 8 } } NOT = { check_variable = { i = 9 } } NOT = { check_variable = { i = 10 } } NOT = { check_variable = { i = 11 } } NOT = { check_variable = { i = 12 } } check_variable = { party_pop_array^i > COLDWAR_DDR_best_pop } }
						set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_best = i }
						set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_best_pop = party_pop_array^i }
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_best = 4 } } COLDWAR_DDR_restore_party_rule = yes }
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = COLDWAR_DDR_best }
				change_ruling_party_effect = yes
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_best = 0 } } retire_country_leader = yes create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_alexander_schalck_golodkowski" ideology = Western_Autocracy traits = { western_Western_Autocracy } } }
